Next I’ll add failing regression tests, then fix the shared type walk and binding diagnostic.The four declaration diagnostic gaps are fixed. Source failures now point at the offending original form with UTF-8 offsets; the independent probe passes unchanged.

## What was wrong

Independently reproduced with the frozen root probe (prefix `// original UTF-8 offsets: λ🙂`):

| Case | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parameter `Quantity<Units<Missing,1>,0>` | `TYPE_NAME` synthetic `0:0` | source span on `Missing` |
| State `ScaledAmount<Missing,2>` | `TYPE_NAME` synthetic `0:0` | source span on `Missing` |
| Parameter `Record<Missing>` | `TYPE_NAME` synthetic `0:0` | source span on `Missing` |
| Repay `nominalAmount: UInt128` | `OPERATION_BINDING` on whole `TransferFields` | source span on `nominalAmount: UInt128;` |

Root cause: parameter types and several indexed constructors skipped source-aware resolution and fell through `validateSchema`. Binding failures always used the Transfer record span instead of the field that actually failed.

## Changes

- `experiments/moriarty-language/src/successor/financial-agreement-source-v1.ts`  
  Walks every declared `TypeNode` (record fields, state, parameters), including nested `Option`/`Collection` and Amount/Quantity/ScaledAmount/Shares/Price/AmountProduct/Record/Enum/Variant/Operation forms. Failures keep the inner identifier’s original span.
- `experiments/moriarty-language/src/successor/funded-expression-source-v1.ts`  
  Shared `operationBinding` now carries internal `{ operation, field }` detail. Public funded rejections stay `{ status: "Rejected", code: "OPERATION_BINDING" }` with no extra fields.
- `experiments/moriarty-language/tests/financial-agreement-source.test.mjs`  
  New test `declared type and binding failures keep original UTF-8 spans on the offending form` covering the four probe cases plus nested/indexed constructors.

`independent-diagnostic-probes.mjs` was not modified (sha256 `bdaf78d8a2b816f00938f1dab86e17c21e300574a02b0e8c15c7d50934fbe311`).
